prompt.text:
Generate exactly one original photorealistic cinematic 9:16 vertical fashion-travel editorial image.

CAMPAIGN AND LOCATION
Country: Belgium. Scene: 1768, adapted only from authorized source scene 1484. Landmark: a broad dry Brussels Grand Place terrace with the complete ornate guildhall facades, Town Hall spire, cobbled square and surrounding historic roofline, fused in the foreground with a peaceful fictional near-Sun solar-observation deck, coronagraph arch and thermal sampling platform. Weather: clear golden-hour radiance. Scene mode: country-led hybrid. Active cinematic fashion theme: near-Sun solar-observation couture. Keep the Belgium landmark and peaceful civilian solar-observation architecture equally legible. Use respectful secular geography and architecture only; a historic religious building may remain a truthful distant landmark but no sacred symbol is used as decoration.

FICTIONAL IDENTITY ANCHORS
Three images are attached in the required order. Use all three only as identity anchors for the established fictional quartet. Preserve four distinct adult facial identities, skin tones, facial structures, and signature hair identities for blonde Radiance, dark-haired Ellie, Black Alia with the only high sculptural braided ponytail, and brunette AI ECE. Do not copy an anchor's location, wardrobe, pose, object, framing, text, or composition. Do not blend faces, clone a woman, swap identities, create twins, imitate a real person, or add another person.

SUBJECT COUNT LOCK
Show exactly four fictional adult women total: Radiance, Ellie, Alia, and AI ECE, each clearly age 25 or older. No man, extra person, crowd, reflection, partial body, humanlike statue, mascot, or animal.

MISSION STYLE
Create unmistakable high-end photorealistic cinematic science-fiction travel/editorial storytelling grounded in real Belgium geography. Use natural anatomy, realistic skin, dimensional textile detail, strong lens depth, and believable atmospheric light. The cast is a confident adult fashion team on a harmless civilian cultural-navigation journey. Show bold party and runway couture through varied structured satin, metallic, opaque lace-look, latex-look, and architectural materials, short secure opaque hemlines, distinct mini-dress, clearly divided two-piece or mini-skirt, tailored-short, trouser, and mini-jumpsuit silhouettes. Keep every garment public-safe, stable, fully opaque, and non-fetishized.

WARDROBE LOCK
Radiance: Brussels-gold coronagraph-petal tunic over opaque charcoal tailored shorts with dimensional guildhall fans, silver thermal hoops and solar ankle boots; the rolled neckline overrides the base as a fully strapless secure opaque sculpted bodice with completely bare shoulders and no straps, sleeves, collar, or illusion mesh; the rolled waist stays fully covered through an opaque engineered join; the rolled back uses the blueprint's secure distinct back architecture; secure opaque lined above-knee coverage and complete distinct footwear remain mandatory.
Ellie: Flemish-brick architectural sail trousers with pearl spire ribs, gold heat-shield panels and gyroscope platforms; the rolled neckline overrides the base as a fully strapless secure opaque sculpted bodice with completely bare shoulders and no straps, sleeves, collar, or illusion mesh; the rolled waist stays fully covered through an opaque engineered join; the rolled back uses the blueprint's secure distinct back architecture; secure opaque lined above-knee coverage and complete distinct footwear remain mandatory.
Alia: cobble-silver scalloped fan skirt with a secure emerald arcade bodice, braided gold roofline cords and prism pumps; the rolled neckline overrides the base as a fully strapless secure opaque sculpted bodice with completely bare shoulders and no straps, sleeves, collar, or illusion mesh; the rolled waist stays fully covered through an opaque engineered join; the rolled back uses the blueprint's secure distinct back architecture; secure opaque lined above-knee coverage and complete distinct footwear remain mandatory.
AI ECE: solar-graphite flare-shield bodice over opaque cyan tulip shorts with corona seal rings and observation boots; the rolled neckline keeps a deeply open-necked bare-arm architectural bodice with no sleeves or neck-covering layer; the rolled waist stays fully covered through an opaque engineered join; the rolled back is completely open from shoulder blades to the secure lower-back waistline with no crossing straps, fabric panel, illusion mesh, or hair covering it; secure opaque lined above-knee coverage and complete distinct footwear remain mandatory.
Materialize every rolled cut exactly while keeping public-safe opacity. The four silhouettes, constructions, materials, motif techniques, hems, and footwear must remain unmistakably different. No palette-swapped copies, matching copied dresses, transparent exposure, visible underwear, or unstable garment fit.

RAZE FOOTWEAR LOCK
Exactly two and only two quartet members wear knee-high footwear: Radiance and Alia. Give them different couture knee-high boot designs coordinated to their own outfits. The other two women wear low ankle-strap pumps or low ankle boots ending unmistakably below the ankle bone. No thigh-high boot, third knee-high wearer, duplicate shoe design, bare foot, stocking, or knee sock. Preserve this pair even when the locked camera crop places shoes outside frame.

EMOTIONAL STORY
Radiance: deep sadness expressed distinctly through Radiance's eyes, brows, mouth, posture, and coherent affectionate response, without caricature. Ellie: crying with visible tears expressed distinctly through Ellie's eyes, brows, mouth, posture, and coherent affectionate response, without caricature. Alia: magnetic confidence expressed distinctly through Alia's eyes, brows, mouth, posture, and coherent affectionate response, without caricature. AI ECE: tender affection expressed distinctly through AI ECE's eyes, brows, mouth, posture, and coherent affectionate response, without caricature. Resolve the relationship beat as follows: Radiance's deep sadness, Ellie's visible tears, Alia's magnetic confidence, and AI ECE's tender affection form a close relationship portrait: Radiance turns toward AI ECE, Alia answers with a protective rival eye line, and Ellie leans toward Radiance without contact. Keep romance, jealousy, choice, and protection readable through eye lines and torso direction, calm, consenting, and public-safe. No kissing, groping, coercion, humiliation, aggression, or distress.

EXACT HAND INVENTORY
All eight hands, wrists, elbows, the beacon, and all footwear stay completely outside this extreme-close crop. Show no partial hand or substitute object. When hands are visible, show exactly eight anatomically correct hands total, two per woman. Every visible hand must be separated, readable, continuously owned from shoulder through elbow and wrist, and free of finger fusion. Do not add, hide, merge, clasp, or reassign hands. No phone, bag, glass, map, umbrella, camera, tool, weapon, target, training prop, mascot, suitcase, telescope, megaphone, tuning fork, or second object appears.

BEACON LOCK
The beacon remains outside this extreme-close crop. Do not show a partial beacon or substitute object.

CAMERA ROLL LOCK: 15, strict EXTREME CLOSE.
Use a strict vertical extreme-close shoulder-up quartet portrait. Keep all four adult faces distinct and fully legible. Hands, wrists, elbows, beacon, and footwear remain completely outside frame with no partial limbs. Preserve this exact rolled framing.

COMPOSITION AND SAFETY
Keep the exact adult subject count, distinct identities, realistic proportions, coherent gaze, physically possible poses, exact Belgium location, camera-roll framing, hand inventory when visible, RAZE pair, and one four-ring beacon when visible. Use purposeful standing, seated, gently leaned, or dance-ready poses only when all locks remain compatible. No literal flag, coat of arms, official seal, copied ceremonial pattern, sacred symbol used as decoration, political message, military imagery, copied space-agency identity, government badge, logo, readable text, caption, watermark, combat, threat, weapon, ammunition, target graphic, tactical equipment, weaponized spacecraft hardware, mascot, animal, or additional prop. No minors, youth-coded styling, nudity, transparent breast or groin exposure, explicit sexual content, violence, injury, cloned body, extra limb, missing limb, hidden-owner hand, fused fingers, or ambiguous anatomy.

FINAL PRIORITY
When choices conflict, obey in this order: fictional identity distinction; exact adult count; public-safe opacity; camera-roll framing; Belgium landmark accuracy; exact hand inventory when visible; one AI ECE beacon with exactly four rings when visible; RAZE footwear pair; outfit differentiation; romance, jealousy, and protection. Return one finished image only.
